I don't know yet. Corvane hasn't set a 2027 per-item fee. The renewal is still being negotiated and nothing is in writing.

- **Today:** Corvane charges $0.08 per ACH item [1]. October's invoice matches that rate: $14,212.40 for 177,655 items [5].
- **Contract:** The current Corvane agreement runs until March 31, 2027, so $0.08 should apply until then [1].
- **Plan assumption:** The Q1 2027 pricing memo assumes the fee stays at $0.08 for all of 2027 [1].
- **Latest news (Nov 16):** That assumption may not hold. Marcus says Paula Brandt, our Corvane relationship manager, hinted they want to raise the per-item fee after the Nov 10 rejected-file incident. There's no written offer yet, and the renewal call moved to the week of Nov 23 [6].
- **Why it matters:** The memo says to revisit the bottom pricing tier (0.50% up to $5M) if the fee goes above $0.10 [1]. Marcus says the Corvane fee only affects our margin, not customer pricing, so the Nov 24 notices go out either way [6].

Marcus is the person to ask after his call with Corvane the week of Nov 23.
